title: SvgDefs
responsibility: Renders the native defs element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgDefs.attributes
inputs.description: Native defs attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgDefs.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native defs element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgDefs
outputs.description: The actual native defs element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
